sources.quote: Laptop, tent, stand, and tablet modes supported by 360 degree sound-bar hinge
3x USB-C (Thunderbolt 4 / USB4 40Gbps), with USB PD 3.0 and DisplayPort 1.4

notes: AXIS MAPPING (laptop vendors invert phone-vendor axis names): Lenovo publishes closed-state Dimensions (WxDxH) = 299.1 x 203.9 x 15.95 mm; mapped manufacturer WIDTH 299.1 -> dimensions_mm.closed.width, manufacturer DEPTH 203.9 -> dimensions_mm.closed.height, manufacturer HEIGHT/thickness 15.95 -> dimensions_mm.closed.depth. This means closed.width (299.1) is the LONG axis, contrary to SPEC's default 'height = long axis' convention. dimensions_mm.open left null: Lenovo publishes no opened dimension for this machine. mass_g: PSREF states 'Starting at 1.34 kg' -> 1.34 x 1000 = 1340 g exactly; this is a STARTING weight and varies by configuration. The 2023-01-05 Lenovo press release states 1.38 kg for the same machine - PSREF (the later, model-specific spec database, doc dated February 05 2024) is preferred and the discrepancy is recorded here. TWO DISCRETE PANELS (not a fold): PSREF lists '2x 13.3"', recorded as roles primary + secondary; they are identical. active_area_mm derived from sourced diagonal + sourced resolution assuming square pixels: w = 13.3 x 2880 / sqrt(2880^2+1800^2) x 25.4 = 286.5 mm, h = 13.3 x 1800 / sqrt(2880^2+1800^2) x 25.4 = 179.0 mm. hinge.free_stop null - Lenovo documents no free-stop/FreeStop behaviour. hinge.axis 'long' is read from the 360-degree sound-bar hinge joining two panels along their long edge, not from a quoted axis statement. PORTS: PSREF lists only '3x USB-C (Thunderbolt 4)'; there is NO headphone jack and no HDMI on this model. Port left/right position left null - the PSREF overview callouts are image labels with no machine-readable side, so side assignment would be a guess. materials.cover_glass null - PSREF's display Key Features row ends with the bare word 'Glass' but names no cover-glass product. released null - the Lenovo press release says only 'expected to be available starting June 2023', which is not a full date.
